summary: Frontend E2E test of contact messaging (public /contact consent checkbox + admin Messages tab: status badges, consent line, reply composer, simulated failure/retry, double-click, mark handled/new, delete) at desktop 1920 and mobile 390. All 8 requested scenarios PASS. I also inserted one old-format message directly into Mongo for testing. It displayed as Nouveau + 'non autorisé', and replies to it were blocked. All 4 test messages were deleted through the UI (the DB now holds 0 contact-test messages).

minor.issue: If deliver() raises an exception that is not a ValueError (e.g. network error from send_email in real mode), the reply entry stays in status 'sending' forever. The $ne 'sending' filter then blocks every future reply to that message with a 409. Wrap the send in try/except and mark the entry as failed.

ui_bugs.issue: The double-send guard uses React state (`sending`), so clicks fired in the same tick (3 synchronous JS clicks) sent 3 POSTs. The backend request_id check stopped any duplicate (only 1 reply was stored), but the 409s showed a red error toast next to the success toast. The catch block also creates a new reqId on the 409, which weakens the protection. A real mouse double-click (page.dblclick) sent only 1 POST and showed only the success toast. Fix: add a useRef boolean guard, and on a 409 do not create a new reqId or show an error.

issues: Once a message has the status 'Réponse envoyée' (answered), there is no 'Marquer comme traité' button, so an answered message can never be set to 'Traité'. Consider showing mark-handled for the answered status too.

action_items: Optional: add a useRef synchronous guard in ReplyBox.send and handle 409 quietly (keep the reqId, no error toast)
Optional: let answered messages be marked 'Traité'
Optional: in the reply route, catch unexpected exceptions from deliver() so no entry stays stuck in 'sending'
critical_code_review_comments: contact_admin.py reply(): an exception other than ValueError leaves the reply in 'sending', which blocks all later replies to the message
MessagesPanel ReplyBox: `sending` state guard is not synchronous; reqId is regenerated on every error, including 409
seed_data_creation: Created 3 messages via /contact (noconsent@, consent@, mobile@contact-test.example.com) and inserted 1 old-format message directly into Mongo (id test-oldformat-0001). All 4 were deleted through the UI delete dialog.

Handled and new toggles work. Delete needs SUPPRIMER typed. Mobile 390: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390) and long emails wrap.
